name: create_agent
description: Create an AI agent with model, instructions, and tools. Use list_models to find valid chat model IDs. The agent only supports chat models.

name: create_datapoints
description: Create one or more datapoints in a dataset

name: create_dataset
description: Create a new dataset

name: create_deployment
description: Create a prompt deployment with a model configuration and messages. Use list_models to find valid chat model IDs. Messages support {{variable}} template syntax for dynamic content.

name: create_experiment
description: Create an experiment from a dataset. Specify task type: "prompt" with model configurations, or "agent" with agent keys. Use auto_run to queue for immediate execution.

name: create_llm_eval
description: Create an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator. The model must support function calling. Use list_models to find valid model IDs. The prompt can reference {{output.response}}, {{input.user_query}}, {{input.expected_output}}, {{input.all_messages}}, {{input.system_instructions}}, {{input.retrievals}} and {{output.tools_called}}. Legacy {{log.*}} variables are still supported.

name: create_python_eval
description: Create a Python code evaluator. The code must define an `evaluate(log)` function that returns a boolean or number. The `log` dict has keys: input, output, reference, expected_output (a duplicate of reference), retrievals, messages and tool_calls.

name: create_skill
description: Create a new skill. Skills are modular markdown instructions that codify processes or conventions.

name: delete_datapoints
description: Delete one or more datapoints from a dataset

name: delete_dataset
description: Delete a dataset and all its datapoints

name: delete_entity
description: Delete any entity in the workspace by type and ID. Supported types: agent, dataset, deployment, prompt, experiment, evaluator, knowledge, memory_store, prompt_snippet, sheet, tool.

name: delete_skill
description: Permanently delete a skill by its ID.

name: find_log_patterns
description: Find stable templates in a bounded sample of matching logs. Returns counts, percentages, time bounds, and bounded sample IDs rather than raw bodies.

name: get_agent
description: Retrieve an agent by its key or ID. Returns the full agent configuration including model, instructions, tools, knowledge bases, and settings.

name: get_analytics_overview
description: Get a quick workspace analytics snapshot: total requests, cost, tokens, errors, error rate, average latency, and top 5 models. Zero-config entry point for understanding workspace usage.

name: get_deployment
description: Retrieve a deployment by its key or ID. Returns the deployment configuration including model, messages, and variant settings.

name: get_experiment_run
description: Export an experiment run and return a signed download URL. The file contains the full row data including inputs, outputs, evaluator scores, cost, and latency.

name: get_llm_eval
description: Retrieve an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator by its key or ID. Returns the full evaluator configuration including prompt, model, output type, mode, and description.

name: get_log
description: Retrieve one OpenTelemetry log record by its ID.

name: get_log_context
description: Retrieve a log and matching records immediately before and after it, in chronological order.

name: get_python_eval
description: Retrieve a Python code evaluator by its key or ID. Returns the full evaluator configuration including code, output type, and description.

name: get_skill
description: Retrieve a skill by its ID. Returns the full skill configuration including instructions.

name: get_span
description: Retrieve a single span by its ID. Use mode "compact" for metadata only (fast) or "full" to include the complete input/output content (slower).

name: invoke_agent
description: Invoke an agent using the Responses API. The model param must follow the format "agent/{agent_key}". Returns the full response resource.

name: invoke_model
description: Invoke a model using the Responses API. The model param must follow the format "provider/model". Returns the full response resource.

name: list_datapoints
description: List datapoints in a dataset

name: list_experiment_runs
description: List experiment runs (manifest snapshots) for the workspace. Optionally filter by sheet_id. Returns runs sorted newest-first with cursor pagination.

name: list_log_facet_values
description: List bounded distinct values and counts for one native or dynamic log facet field.

name: list_log_facets
description: Discover native and dynamic log fields with bounded top values and occurrence counts. Use this before constructing filters for unfamiliar data.

name: list_models
description: list all the available AI models in the system

name: list_skills
description: List skills in the current workspace. Results are paginated using starting_after / ending_before cursors.

name: list_spans
description: List all spans belonging to a specific trace. Returns span data (id, name, type, timing, parent_id) for tree reconstruction. Use get_span with mode "full" to retrieve input/output content for individual spans.

name: list_trace_logs
description: List OpenTelemetry logs correlated to a trace, using the backend cursor unchanged.

name: list_traces
description:
List traces for a workspace with filtering support.

Available filters:
- model: Filter by LLM model (e.g. "gpt-4o", "claude-sonnet-4-20250514")
- type: Filter by leading span type (e.g. "generation", "retrieval", "agent")
- entity_key: Filter by deployment/entity key
- project_id: Filter by project ID
- trace_id: Filter by specific trace ID
- thread_id: Filter by thread ID
- identity_id: Filter by contact/identity ID (e.g. "contact_01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV")
- search: Full-text search across trace fields
- start_time_after: Only return traces starting after this time (ISO 8601)
- start_time_before: Only return traces starting before this time (ISO 8601)

Without time bounds, searches the last 24 hours. An end time alone searches the 24 hours ending at that time. A start time alone searches from that time until now. The applied window is returned in metadata and preserved across cursor pages.

Annotation/evaluation filters:
- evaluator_key: Filter by annotation/evaluator key OR id (e.g. "rating" or "01HXXX...")
- eval_score_min: Minimum evaluation score (inclusive)
- eval_score_max: Maximum evaluation score (inclusive)
- eval_passed: Filter by passed status (true/false)
- eval_label: Filter by evaluation label value

Results are sorted by timestamp descending (most recent first).

name: query_analytics
description: Flexible drill-down into workspace analytics. Query usage, cost, latency, errors, agent, or model performance metrics from pre-aggregated rollup tables. Supports time ranges, grouping, filtering, and granularity control.

name: query_log_aggregates
description: Query log_count, error_count, and error_rate through the shared TelemetryService query envelope.

name: retrieve_agent_response
description: Retrieve a previously created agent response by its ID. Returns the full response resource including output, usage, and status.

name: search_directories
description: List direct child directories for a project, sorted by display_name ascending.

name: search_docs
description: Search the orq.ai documentation for guides, API references, and tutorials. Returns matching pages with title, description, content snippet, and a direct link.

name: search_entities
description: Search projects, datasets, prompts, evaluators, or experiments in the current workspace. Use type to scope results and query to match names, keys, or descriptions.

name: search_logs
description: Search OpenTelemetry logs with free text and the shared telemetry filter dialect, or run an OQL `fetch logs` pipeline. Results are newest first and cursor-paginated.

name: submit_feedback
description: Send feedback about orq.ai APIs, MCP tools, SDKs, or documentation by email to support@orq.ai. Include what happened and what you expected, with a request ID or relevant URL when available. Do not include API keys, tokens, passwords, or other secrets. Each submission sends a new email; do not retry automatically.

name: update_agent
description: Update an existing agent's configuration and publish a new semantic version. Provide versionIncrement and versionDescription with every update.

name: update_datapoint
description: Update a datapoint

name: update_llm_eval
description: Update an existing LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator. Only the fields provided in updates will be changed; all other fields remain unchanged.

name: update_python_eval
description: Update an existing Python code evaluator. Only the fields provided in updates will be changed; all other fields remain unchanged.

name: update_skill
description: Update an existing skill. Only the fields provided will change; omitted fields keep their current values.
